The '''''Borogove''''' was a [[bulk freighter]] resembling a pregnant [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]. It was operated by self-proclaimed master [[thief]] [[Cecil Noone]] and his [[Cecil Noone's crew|gang]] as of [[0 ABY]]. The vessel was abandoned during a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|heist]] on the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]'' in that year, after which the crew transferred to the Bimm [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ritinki]]'s personal [[Yacht/Legends|star yacht]] ''[[Asaari Wind]]''.

==History==
While using their [[bulk freighter]] ''Borogove'' during an attempted grand larceny in [[0 ABY]], [[Cecil Noone]]'s gang of [[Thief|thieves]] got in conflict with a [[Sector Ranger]] [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol boat]]. The ''Borogove'' was damaged and the thieves landed it in the [[Kamar Badlands|Badlands]] of the [[planet]] [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]] for repairs. Noone's gang member [[Hass Sonax]], a [[Sluissi]] technician, patched the ship while her partners devoted their time to other activities.

As the ship was fixed, Noone received a private message from his employer, gangster [[Guttu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], demanding their presence in Guttu's lair on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Noone and his crew traveled to the moon on the ''Borogove'', after which the freighter was used to infiltrate the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]'' in orbit to steal a valuable box at Guttu's behest. While searching the Bimm [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ritinki]]'s yacht for the box, Sonax and demolitions expert [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] were forced to take control of the vessel and extricate Noone and [[Kels Turkhorn]] from the herdship. The crew escaped on the ''Asaari Wind'', effectively abandoning the ''Borogove''; while Dawson was stricken at leaving the freighter behind, Noone joked that the [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] was free to return to Nar Shaddaa and attempt to release it from the local impound.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Borogove'' first appeared in the short story "[[The Great Herdship Heist]]", which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and featured in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 15]] in [[November]] [[1997]].
